name: 14540-longprompt-16b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, bf16 sparse MoE with multi-head latent attention: 27 layers, hidden 2048, 16 attention heads, 64 routed + 2 shared experts at top-6, 15.7B parameters (~2.4B activated), ~31.4 GB of weights, context window 163840. The base checkpoint, not the `-Chat` variant.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=50, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, 500 requests bounded, safety_seconds 1800, static seed 14540.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, every request identical in shape: 3000 prompt tokens in, 1000 tokens out, min == max == mean on both, so no length dispersion. Prompts are distinct; no prefix buckets. `request_format: plain` — the prompt string reaches the engine as written, with no chat template, which is the completions-shaped reading of the source's offline invocation and the right one for a base (non-`-Chat`) checkpoint. Tokenized with add_special_tokens=True, so the engine reports a little over 3000 prompt tokens per request.
purpose: A long-document drafting assistant on a 16-billion-parameter sparse model, serving 50 concurrent 3000-token prompts on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine arguments.
#
# HAZARD: `VLLM_USE_V1` must be 1 in the process environment before the engine starts -- it
# defaults to 0 at this engine and there is no CLI flag. Without it the engine dies in
# `create_engine_config` at startup; that means the variable is missing, not that a value here
# needs changing.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
tensor-parallel-size: 1
trust-remote-code: true
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 16384
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
